layman_headline: Fear is gripping the crypto market — no clear swing trade setup stands out right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful state with the Fear & Greed Index at 28 and trending worse over the past week. Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.4%, which means money is flowing out of altcoins and into Bitcoin for safety. Most of the swing trade candidates are either in confirmed downtrends with bearish chart structures, or have already rallied so hard (like UB at +60% in a week) that chasing them carries high risk. The news landscape shows potential headwinds from yen carry trade fears and regulatory uncertainty around the Clarity Act.
layman_action: Stay patient and keep your cash ready. The market is nervous and most altcoins are bleeding. Wait for the fear to stabilize or reverse before committing capital — better setups will come when the selling exhausts itself.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven candidates systematically. UB has the strongest chart bias (+1.10) with Three White Soldiers, but it's up 59.6% in 7 days — chasing a 60% move violates swing trading discipline and the risk/reward to resistance is only 0.49x. TRUMP has the best RSI signal (26.22, deeply oversold — our most reliable signal type at 71% win rate), but the chart is bearish with price below all MAs and the coin is down 98% from ATH, suggesting structural decline rather than a dip to buy. MON and FET are approaching oversold but have bearish chart structures with no reversal signals yet. BEAT dropped 20% but has zero technical data to confirm a bottom. AAVE is neutral across the board. The macro environment is hostile for alts: BTC dominance at 56.4%, Fear & Greed worsening at 28, and news headwinds from yen carry trade concerns and regulatory uncertainty. Per my validated rules, when Fear & Greed is near 25 and the outlook is ambiguous, HOLD is the safest call.
